name: OMeGa Joint Representation
aliases: Joint Optimization of Explicit Meshes and Gaussian Splats
definition: An end-to-end framework that jointly optimizes an explicit triangle mesh and 2D Gaussian splats via a flexible binding strategy, where spatial attributes of Gaussian Splats are expressed in the mesh frame and texture attributes are retained on splats.
summary: OMeGa is a joint representation framework that optimizes explicit triangle meshes and Gaussian splats simultaneously, binding splats to mesh faces to decouple geometry from texture and enable adaptive density control.
